blocks.prompt: 18. Consider the complex encryption key \(k = 3 - 3i\). Encrypt the word "QUIZ", and then recover the original word using the inverse of the key.
blocks.explanation: Yeh bilkul Sawal 17 wala tareeqa hai, bas key ab \(k = 3 - 3i\) hai. Encrypt: har letter ki value ko k se zarb. Asal lafz wapas: inverse \(k^{-1}\) se zarb, jaisa sawal khud kehta hai. Is key mein ek khoobsurti hai: \(3 - 3i = 3(1 - i)\), jis se hisaab bohat chhota ho jata hai.
steps:
Given (diya gaya hai): lafz QUIZ, key \(k = 3 - 3i\), A = 1, ..., Z = 26.
To find (maloom karna hai): encrypted numbers, phir \(k^{-1}\) se asal lafz.
Method (tareeqa): encrypted \(= z \times k\); wapas \(= (z \times k) \times k^{-1}\).

Qadam 1: Letters ko complex numbers banayein
\[Q = 17 + 0i, \quad U = 21 + 0i\]
\[I = 9 + 0i, \quad Z = 26 + 0i\]
Kyun: Q satrahwan letter hai, U ikkeeswan, I nawan, Z chhabbeeswan (aakhri). Ginti mein ghalti na ho, is liye alphabet ungliyon par gin kar check kar lein.

Qadam 2: Encrypt (k se zarb)
\[17(3 - 3i) = 51 - 51i\]
\[21(3 - 3i) = 63 - 63i\]
\[9(3 - 3i) = 27 - 27i\]
\[26(3 - 3i) = 78 - 78i\]
Kyun: letter ki value ko k ke dono parts se zarb kiya.

Qadam 3: Key ka inverse
\[k^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{3 - 3i} \times \dfrac{3 + 3i}{3 + 3i}\]
\[= \dfrac{3 + 3i}{9 + 9} = \dfrac{3 + 3i}{18}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 + i}{6}\]
Kyun: conjugate \(3 + 3i\) se upar neeche zarb kiya taake neeche real ho jaye: \(9 + 9 = 18\). Phir upar neeche se common factor 3 cancel kiya.

Qadam 4: Pehla letter wapas laayein
\[(51 - 51i)\cdot\dfrac{1 + i}{6} = \dfrac{51(1 - i)(1 + i)}{6}\]
\[= \dfrac{51 \times 2}{6} = 17 \;\Rightarrow\; Q\]
Kyun: \(51 - 51i = 51(1 - i)\), aur \((1 - i)(1 + i) = 1 - i^{2} = 1 + 1 = 2\). Phir \(\frac{102}{6} = 17\), yani Q.

Qadam 5: Baqi letters
\[(63 - 63i)\cdot\dfrac{1 + i}{6} = \dfrac{126}{6} = 21 \Rightarrow U\]
\[(27 - 27i)\cdot\dfrac{1 + i}{6} = \dfrac{54}{6} = 9 \Rightarrow I\]
\[(78 - 78i)\cdot\dfrac{1 + i}{6} = \dfrac{156}{6} = 26 \Rightarrow Z\]
Kyun: har encrypted number (value)\((1 - i)\cdot 3\) hai, is liye har baar wohi factor \(\frac{2}{6}\) aata hai aur nateeja \(\text{value} \times 3 \times \frac{2}{6} = \text{value}\).

Tasdeeq (check): \(k \cdot k^{-1} = (3 - 3i)\cdot\frac{1 + i}{6} = \frac{3(1 - i)(1 + i)}{6} = \frac{6}{6} = 1\).
Kyun: inverse ki pehchaan yahi hai ke key se zarb karne par 1 aaye; isi liye wapas asal values milti hain.
